name: Alex G
label: RCA
lede: Alex Giannascoli was 17 when he started putting albums on Bandcamp from Havertown, Pennsylvania. Frank Ocean emailed, Domino signed him, and in 2024 RCA did too; on Headlights, his tenth album, he still plays most of the instruments himself.

eras.title: Sandy on Bandcamp
eras.text: Alex Giannascoli records alone in Havertown and posts all of it to Bandcamp. There's no label and no band, just a page at sandy.bandcamp.com.

years.src: Wikipedia: Alex G · Spin: (Sandy) Alex G
years.h: A Havertown teenager puts his albums on Bandcamp
years.p: Alexander Giannascoli is 17 when he starts self-releasing albums, EPs and singles as Alex G, all recorded at home after school at Haverford High.
years.xp: Wikipedia dates his first releases to 2010. Before that came school bands with silly names: MOTHER, a goth-techno project with his sister Rachel, The Scoli Xtreme with his brother, and The Skin Cells, which he has described as pop rock that accidentally ended up punk.

years.h: Temple University gets him until the records take over
years.p: Giannascoli enrolls at Temple to study English, with teaching in mind, and drops out to make records.

years.h: A dog at a funeral becomes the cover of Trick
years.p: The photo shows a German Shepherd bolting down the aisle of a Philadelphia church. Trick goes up on Bandcamp in November.
years.xp:
His sister Rachel took the cover photo at their grandmother's funeral at St. Donato Roman Catholic Church in Philadelphia. Giannascoli has said a dog of unknown ownership ran in and out again.

Lucky Number later reissued the album in Europe.

eras.title: Orchid Tapes, then Domino
eras.text: Orchid Tapes puts out DSU, Lucky Number brings it to Europe, and Domino signs him. The songs still get made at home.

years.h: Orchid Tapes releases DSU in June
years.p: It runs 32 minutes and is his label debut. His sister's suggestion of "Dream State" turned into Dream State University, a fake college.
years.xp:
Rachel Giannascoli suggested Dream State after hearing the songs, and he riffed it into Dream State University, a joke on American state schools. He had second thoughts at the last minute; the acronym stuck anyway.

Emily Yacina sings on several tracks. Pitchfork later put DSU at No. 165 on its list of the 200 best albums of the 2010s.

years.cap: Alex G at the 100 Club, London
years.src: Wikipedia: Alex G · Wikipedia: Trick · It's All Indie
years.h: London's Lucky Number puts DSU out in Europe
years.p: The label adds two bonus tracks and reissues the early Bandcamp albums Rules and Trick.
years.xp:
Wikipedia dates the Lucky Number release of DSU, with two bonus tracks, and the Rules and Trick reissues to November 2014. The Trick page lists a Lucky Number mastering date of April 2015, so sources differ.

When he played the 100 Club in London on October 20, 2015, the crowd was around 200 and the band was two guitars, bass and drums, a stripped-back version of the records, according to It's All Indie's review.

years.cap: Alex G and band at SXSW, Austin, March 2015
years.src: Wikipedia: Alex G · Spin: (Sandy) Alex G
years.h: Domino signs him, and the method stays the same
years.p: Beach Music, out October 9, is his first album for Domino Recording Company, after six years of uploading his own recordings.
years.xp: Rolling Stone announced the album in August 2015. Spin noted that after six years of self-recorded uploads this was the leap from Bandcamp to a big indie.

eras.title: Frank Ocean's guitarist
eras.text: Frank Ocean emails a kid from Havertown. Giannascoli plays on Endless and Blonde, joins Ocean's live band, puts his name in parentheses and makes Rocket with Molly Germer.

years.big: "He would give me a vocal part and I would try to write stuff under it."
q: He would give me a vocal part and I would try to write stuff under it.
years.src: Spin: (Sandy) Alex G · Wikipedia: Alex G · Pitchfork: Alex G Opens Up
years.h: Frank Ocean emails, and Alex G ends up on Endless and Blonde
years.p: Giannascoli plays guitar and helps with arrangements on both of Ocean's 2016 records, working mostly from parts Ocean had already recorded.
years.xp:
Spin reports that Ocean contacted him by email, and that the work happened over recordings rather than in a room together, though Ocean sometimes visited. Giannascoli was modest about it. "He just took the little pieces that worked for him," he said, and he told Spin he didn't do that much.

Pitchfork ran a 2016 piece in which Giannascoli talked about the sessions. He also joined Ocean's live band on guitar in 2017.

years.src: Wikipedia: Alex G · Spin: (Sandy) Alex G · Stereogum
years.h: He becomes (Sandy) Alex G, no explanation offered
years.p: He announces the new name on April 4, 2017. Spin traces it to another artist, Alexandra Gronlund, who trademarked "Alex G" in December 2015.
years.xp:
Giannascoli told Spin the tag came from his first Bandcamp page: "Sandy was the first thing I put on Bandcamp, which was always sandy.bandcamp.com." According to Wikipedia, the parentheses were meant to be silent, but people kept saying it aloud.

Stereogum reported later that he had dropped the Sandy for good.

years.h: Rocket adds fiddle and banjo and keeps GarageBand
years.p: Molly Germer's violin and John Heywood's bass are on it, and five singles come out before release day.
years.xp:
Bobby and Witch dropped March 2, Proud on April 4, Brick and Sportstar on May 4. Metacritic lists the album at 82. Spin's profile noted he was still recording largely in GarageBand.

Spin also lists Blood Meridian, The Grapes of Wrath, East of Eden and Of Mice and Men among his recent reading. Esquire and Time Out New York both placed Rocket at No. 5 on their year-end lists.

years.h: Molly Germer plays on every record from Rocket on
years.p: Violinist [[Molly Germer|4ee5bf1c-655f-45f1-a75f-c9539c73f0fc]] plays and sings backing vocals on each of his albums since Rocket, and sometimes joins him in the live band.

eras.title: The parentheses come off
eras.text: House of Sugar arrives in 2019, the (Sandy) leaves, and for God Save the Animals he books studios and a producer. Jane Schoenbrun's first feature gets him writing a score.

years.src: Wikipedia: House of Sugar · Wikipedia: Alex G
years.h: House of Sugar is named for a casino and a witch
years.p: Pitchfork gave it 8.6 and ranked it No. 17 of 2019. Metacritic scored it 86.
years.xp:
Wikipedia says the name refers both to the then-SugarHouse casino in Philadelphia, now Rivers, and to the witch's house in Hansel and Gretel. Four singles came first: Gretel on June 4, Hope on July 15, and Southern Sky and Near in August.

Exclaim! gave the album 9/10.

years.cap: Alex G live in Studio A at WFUV, New York
years.h: The (Sandy) comes off for good
years.p: Management confirms to Stereogum that he's plain Alex G again. Spotify has already switched; Apple Music still lists the old name.
years.xp: Stereogum noted that streaming services had updated his name the week before, with some inconsistency, and signed off with "Farewell to the (Sandy) era!"

years.h: Tomberlin's Projections EP gets Alex G as co-producer
years.p: A side job while touring is off the table: Giannascoli co-produces the October EP for singer-songwriter Tomberlin.

years.cap: Alex G at the Ottobar, Baltimore
years.h: God Save the Animals gets studios and a producer
years.p: His ninth album is the first with producer Jacob Portrait, and the sessions run from Philadelphia to Rhinebeck to Maine.
years.xp: Seven locations, mostly in the Northeast: Headroom and Spice House in Philadelphia, his home, SugarHouse in New York, Clubhouse in Rhinebeck, Gradwell House in Haddon Heights, NJ, and Watersong in Maine. Portrait, bassist in Unknown Mortal Orchestra, co-produced.

years.h: NME gives God Save the Animals five stars
years.p: Four singles come first, then TV spots: Runner on Fallon, Miracles on Colbert. Metacritic lists it at 86.
years.xp: NME praised its "newfound clarity and vulnerability". Paste ranked it No. 2 of the year. It was his highest-charting record to that point, at No. 144 on the Billboard 200.

years.h: Jane Schoenbrun hands him the score to We're All Going to the World's Fair
years.p: It's Schoenbrun's first feature, about a teen and an online horror game.

years.h: Ten years on, Trick finds its audience on TikTok
years.p: Sarah and Mary, both posted to Bandcamp in 2012, blow up on TikTok and Spotify.

eras.title: Headlights
eras.text: He signs with RCA, is booked to open for Foo Fighters, scores a second Schoenbrun film and plays a Bernie Sanders rally. Headlights, his tenth album, comes out in July 2025.

years.big: "I don't feel like I'm that mysterious, I just don't have a lot to say."
q: I don't feel like I'm that mysterious, I just don't have a lot to say.
years.h: Alex G signs with RCA after nine years at Domino
years.p: NME reports the move, with August stadium dates supporting Foo Fighters to follow.
years.xp: Presale for his 2024 US headline tour began January 23, with general sale on January 26, according to NME. Asked about his air of mystery, he gave the magazine the line above.

years.h: Halsey's The Great Impersonator has Alex G on eight tracks
years.p: Giannascoli contributes to eight songs on the pop singer's record.

years.h: Schoenbrun calls again for I Saw the TV Glow
years.p: Second film, second score; he returns for Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma in 2026.

years.h: Alex G plays 30 minutes at a Bernie Sanders rally in Harrisburg
years.p: It's a stop on the "Fighting Oligarchy" tour, in Pennsylvania's capital.

years.cap: Alex G with accordion at the Academy, Manchester, November 2025
years.h: Afterlife is the first thing anyone hears from Headlights
years.p: He announces his tenth album in May and releases Afterlife on May 29; June Guitar and Oranges follow.

years.src: Wikipedia: Headlights · Albumoftheyear · Pitchfork: The (Real) Alex G · Brooklyn Vegan
years.h: Forty minutes of "hi-fi dad rock" on RCA
years.p: Headlights is co-produced with Jacob Portrait, with Molly Germer on violin. Pitchfork gave it 8.5 and ranked it No. 23 of 2025.
years.xp:
Pitchfork's Ian Cohen called it an upgrade to "hi-fi dad rock" and a major-label debut "worthy of all time indie-graduations". Metacritic lists it at 83 from 15 critics. The Guardian praised a tune built around a pan flute.

Giannascoli played most instruments. String players Carolina Diazgranados, Hannah Nicholas, Carlos Santiago and Justin Yoder added parts. It peaked at No. 166 on the Billboard 200. Albumoftheyear.org lists a separate No. 42 for the year.

years.h: Then Coachella
years.p: Wikipedia lists Giannascoli among the acts at the festival in April 2026.
